run_browser_chat_server: run the browser chat server on a specified port using the BrowserManager
setup_browser_chat_args: set up command line arguments for the browser chat server including port and config path
run_browser_manager: run the BrowserManager with given options, starting its task and ensuring shutdown
parse_browser_chat_config: parse a configuration file and merge world options into the browser chat server options
review_browser_chat_entry: review the browser chat runner entry point that sets up args and starts the server
